question: How does Outputs/Mesons overage actually get billed today, if not through Stripe?

stripe.outputs_overage: No Stripe Product/Price/Meter env vars; no reporting code path
stripe.mesons_overage: No Stripe metered overage path; meson_addon_catalog exists for subscription JSON toggles only
stripe.ai_credits_overage: ONLY automatic Stripe path — usage_tracking + stripe.billing.MeterEvent (STRIPE_METER_EVENT_NAME=ai_credits_used) via stripe_metering.py + hourly usage_scheduler

internal_ledger.usage_records.outputs: Read by GET /api/settings/billing-usage and billing overview — NO writer found in backend codebase (only research_lookups inserts to usage_records today)
internal_ledger.overage_usage_table: Written only by apply_usage_with_overage for ai_credits and workflow_runs (usage_tracking family) — NOT outputs or mesons
internal_ledger.billing_plans.overage_rates: DB keys output/meson ($2.50–1.50 / $3–2) used for display-rate intent; not wired to Stripe invoicing

ui.settings_billing_usage: Shows estimated overage_cost_usd using hardcoded $0.01/output in settings.py — display only
ui.pricing_page: Marketing copy $2–3 outputs, $2–4 mesons — not connected to charging

findings.manual_batch_reconciliation: No batch job, cron, or admin script found that invoices output/meson overage outside Stripe ai_credits meter

conclusion: Customers are NOT being automatically charged for Outputs or Mesons overage in the current codebase. Accrued overage (if usage were recorded) would not reach Stripe. This is a pre-existing product/billing gap independent of Research Lookups.
research_lookups_implication: Research Lookups correctly uses a separate Stripe Billing Meter (research_lookups_used) because the Outputs/Mesons pattern is tracking/display-only, not real billing. Outputs/Meson automatic charging remains out of scope unless product decides to backfill that gap separately.
